cap_vs_estimate.interpretation: The cap was not an expected bill. The expected range was also too conservative. The gross metered figure is before credits; credits do not explain the gap.

root_causes: Ninety-minute GPU timeouts versus approximately sixteen-to-eighteen-minute observed calls inflated reservations.
Setup/recovery allowances and unallocated cap margin were presented too close to the expected cost.

Using useful generated-token throughput from one padded batch as a constant across response-length distributions overpredicts this workload. The decoder retains finished rows as padded slots until the batch is done.

controlled_training_candidate.question: Does a short correctness-only GRPO continuation improve its own SFT parent under a fixed inference budget?
controlled_training_candidate.study_type: new prospective three-seed paired pilot; not a replication of the historical 500-step recipe
controlled_training_candidate.primary_endpoint: Completed final numeric answer accuracy; repeated identical numeric boxes accepted prospectively; unfinished thinking fails; report strict original contract separately.
controlled_training_candidate.primary_comparison: Mean paired child-minus-parent effect across three seeds; show each seed and training variability separately, never treat six evaluations as six independent question sets.
controlled_training_candidate.evaluation_subset: Freeze a common random subset excluding the earlier development pilot and 256-question ablation before running.
limits: SFT packing and step counts are estimates until CPU preparation.
The training observations comprise only two SFT updates and six highly variable GRPO updates; scenarios are not a statistical prediction interval.
Use a timing-only calibration and freeze the final prospective protocol before outcome evaluation.
This tests a short continuation at a fixed generation budget; it cannot establish general RL efficacy or the full 500-step outcome.
Any executable quote must separately fit expected costs, per-job reservations, setup and contingency inside the newly agreed remaining cap.

original_full_matrix_estimate: Requires a fresh workload-specific estimate. Do not divide the earlier full-study figure by ten: new training, 4K/8K and sampled protocols have distinct costs and remain incompletely measured.
